mapper.select: select con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Name as conName, sr.Sc_Name as masterConName, sr.Sc_Code as masterConCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as scFpName, c2.C_Name as scSpName, c1.C_Abbreviation as scFpAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as scSpAbbName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Subcontract_Record mn left join Pre_Project pro on mn.P_Id = pro.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join Con_Contract con on mn.Con_Id = con.Con_Id left join Subcontract_Record sr on mn.Sc_Master_Con_Id = sr.Sc_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Sc_Fp = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Sc_Sp = c2.C_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Sc_Id where mn.Sc_Id = #{scId}
